title: Venezuelan Zesty Salad
description: A fresh and crunchy salad inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, with a tangy twist.
instructions: 1. Chop the celery into bite-sized pieces.
2. In a large bowl, combine the chopped celery and mixed greens.
3. Drizzle the Venezuelan zesty sauce over the top of the salad.
4. Toss the salad to coat with the zesty sauce.
5. Serve immediately, garnished with additional zesty sauce if desired.
